name: Trilinear Normal Interpolation
definition: Interpolates the surface normal at an intersection point using trilinear interpolation of the pre-computed grid normals at the 8 corners of the intersecting voxel.
summary: Trilinear Normal Interpolation computes surface normals by interpolating pre-computed vertex vectors, differing from gradient approximation by using stored normals rather than deriving them on-the-fly.
